core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_preference_michael_espresso: Michael prefers a sleek, modern stainless-steel finish; seeks an espresso machine that offers a café-like experience without requiring professional barista skills; values design aesthetics and simplicity in operation.
core_memory.user_inquiry_michael_shipping: Michael is in Seattle and is concerned about shipping times and origin; specifically asks if products are shipped from a local warehouse, and if so, what the delivery timeline is, especially given a family gathering later this month.
core_memory.user_concern_michael_kitchen_space: Michael is concerned about the physical footprint of the Verve Espresso machine in his kitchen, which already has several appliances on the counter. He wants to confirm dimensions to avoid 'kitchen Tetris' and ensure he can reorganize without major disruption.
core_memory.user_inquiry_michael_steam_wand: Michael wants the Verve Espresso with steam wand for matcha lattes and cappuccinos. He’ll move his toaster oven to free up counter space(38 sq ft).
core_memory.user_inquiry_michael_new_customer_discou: Michael is a first-time buyer and wants to apply a 17% off discount at checkout. He needs clear, step-by-step instructions on where to enter the coupon code and how to ensure he doesn’t miss it.
core_memory.user_preference_michael_delivery_signatu: Michael requires signature on delivery for high-value items. He’ll be available to greet courier or bring package in safely, especially in rainy weather to prevent damage.

archival_memory.customer_return_exchange_policy_espresso:
Our return and exchange policy for delayed or lost shipments: 
- If a package is confirmed lost or damaged during transit, we file a claim with the carrier on your behalf.
- You will receive a full refund or a replacement product, depending on your preference.
- The claim process takes 5–10 business days to complete after we verify the loss.
- For first-time buyers, we offer a 15-day window to initiate an exchange or return for any delayed or lost items.
- All claims are reviewed by our fulfillment team, and you’ll receive a confirmation email once the process is complete.
- If the item is damaged, we will replace it with a new one at no cost to you.
